value.rationale: The family is the canonical orthogonal simplex in anisotropic meshing; identifying the worst vertex without cone evaluation and obtaining sharp dimension-only leg-product calibration with rigid equality and degeneration extremizers gives a complete geometric invariant profile. The exact 3D formula and sharpness sequence for an existing general inequality further make the result practically interpretable. This is not merely the known Gaussian representation or a routine finite table.
